title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Development Stream in Zimbabwe, implemented by partners CCJP, ZELA, ZPP and WLSA aims to achieve more accountable relationships between communities and government authorities. The objectives of the grant are to support peace and protection, participation and sustainable use of land, and to support civil society to be more resilient so that they can continue to defend human rights and promote accountability, by supporting rights holders to take action to advance their rights; influencing duty bearers and decision-makers to take action, and strengthening the agency of partner agencies and civil society. At community level the programme targets communities affected by mining activities in Buhera, Goromonzi and Mutoko; Peacebuilding work focuses on Matobo, Mutasa, Marange districts; and in Chipinge, Mutasa and Marange districts on issues of gender inequality and response to GBV.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: ZWE. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Programme objectives are not thematic. The overall programme aims to support more productive and accountable relationships between communities and public authorities. Work that contributes to specific SDG targets will span all objectives through complementary actions and approaches.
